title: AID-IQ
summary: A first-aid learning app that turns emergency knowledge into modules and quizzes.
description: Built with Flutter and Firebase, AID-IQ structures first-aid procedures into interactive lessons, tracks quiz progress, and syncs data so users can quickly recall steps during real emergencies.

title: BUDGET BUDDY
summary: A personal finance app for tracking spending and building savings habits.
description: Built in Flutter with Firebase, Budget Buddy handles authentication, categorized transactions, balance tracking, and spending analytics through a service-locator architecture, giving users a clear view of their financial patterns over time.

title: LINYA
summary: A school publication platform for articles with social-style user engagement.
description: Built with Laravel and PostgreSQL, LINYA separates concerns across models, repositories, services, DTOs, observers, and Livewire components, with Docker providing a containerized development environment.

title: PROUD BISAYA BAI
summary: A publication website centralizing blog content from the Proud Bisaya Bai team.
description: Built with Next.js and Supabase, the site uses a React-based structure of reusable contexts, hooks, utilities, and data modules to organize and deliver content through a responsive web interface.

title: GIMI
summary: A wellness platform to ease student worries, with mood and journal support.
description: Built with a Django REST API, React frontend, and PostgreSQL, GIMI includes an AI chatbot and an optional local-LLM pipeline that analyzes student drawings for emotional indicators, alongside consultation booking with the school's guidance faculty.

title: QREMEMBER
summary: A shared event photo album accessible to guests through a QR code.
description: Built with ASP.NET Core Razor Pages and Entity Framework Core, QRemember uses Supabase PostgreSQL for data, Cloudinary for photo storage, QRCoder for guest access, and ASP.NET Core Identity for organizer authentication.

title: KEH
summary: An AI social media manager for small business owners: you choose the product and goal, Keh writes the captions and picks platforms and timing.
description: Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Supabase (Postgres with Row Level Security, Auth, Storage, Realtime), Keh guides owners through onboarding, products and a campaign wizard where Gemini writes the captions. It adds a calendar, content library and analytics, plus an AI marketing manager that can draft or edit products and campaigns.
